chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar, may Allah be pleased with him, wrote to Abu Muhammad al-Hasan ibn Ali, peace be upon him.
Regarding endowments and what has been narrated about them from his forefathers, peace be upon them.
So he, peace be upon him, wrote in reply: Endowments are to be according to how their owners designate them, if Allah, the Exalted, wills.

key_terms.آبَائِهِ: His forefathers, referring to the preceding Imams عليهم السلام.
key_terms.أَهْلُهَا: Its owners; those entitled to establish it.
key_terms.الْوُقُوفِ: Endowments; property set aside as waqf.
key_terms.تَكُونُ: Are to be or are established.
key_terms.رُوِيَ: Narrated or transmitted in report form.

ai.seo_question: How should endowments be administered according to Imam al-Hasan ibn Ali al-Askari عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning endowments (awqaf). It states that the administration and application of an endowment follow the conditions and designation set by its founder, reflecting the authority of the original stipulation in waqf matters.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5567 - Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan Al-Saffar, may Allah (swt) be pleased with him, wrote to Abu Muhammad Imam Hasan ibn Ali Al-Askari (as), peace be upon him,
regarding endowments (awqaf) and what has been narrated about them from his forefathers (as), peace be upon them.
Imam (as) replied: "Endowments are to be managed according to how their owners have designated them, if Allah (swt), the Exalted, wills."
